method_definition: GLM-5.3 Flash through the GLM Coding Plan and OpenCode generated Blender Python scene code for Table 2; retained final Blender meshes are reused for Table 3 without another model request

structural_metrics.reason: The frozen final output has meshes and descriptive Blender node names but no stable independent-instance graph, unified object roles, or native support edges.

pilot.acceptance_note: Both reviewed plots use the registered ROI and spawn convention; all eight reusable pilot meshes reached terminal evaluation and all twelve unavailable Table-2 slots were retained as ITT zeros.

reuse.eligible: frozen GLM identity, generation_success=true, build_success=true, retained scene.blend, and SUCCESS marker

coordinate_system: Blender meters, Z up, evaluation region centered at X=Y=0

navigation.aggregation: mean over the four seeds inside each specification, then mean over 25 specifications

blender.gpu_reason: Canonical mesh export performs no rendering or neural inference; Blender dependency-graph and Recast operations are CPU-only

python_environment.purpose: Existing Python 3.11 environment for NumPy and the frozen Recast extension; no downloads required

billing: No Table-3 model request; only retained Table-2 artifacts are read

amendments.stage: after the first formal export attempt and before aggregation or reporting
amendments.reason: Two reusable Urban Blender files deterministically contained no upward triangles selected by the frozen pedestrian-surface rules. The already-frozen failure policy requires unusable final geometry to contribute ITT zeros.
amendments.effect: Preserve Table-2 source eligibility at 30/100 Urban; classify two canonical-no-walkable-surface slots as Table-3 ITT, yielding 28 evaluated and 72 ITT Urban slots. No model, scene, semantic rule, threshold, navigation formula, or aggregate value was changed after observation.
